title: [K-Poppin'] "Singlish" Day with DKB(다크비) :It kills me when I can get a hold of you from 🎵 ALL IN♥️
description:
Learn Korean and English on "Singlish" every Monday! DKB joins us every week to learn a pop song the listeners chose! Penalties await too! Every Monday from 1-2pm kst don't forget to join in!

💛 Today’s Guests: 준서(JUNSEO), 유쿠(YUKU), 해리준(HARRY JUNE) from DKB(다크비)
💛 Today’s Singlish:  줄꺼야(ALL IN) -DKB ❤️ 🔥

📌Today's expression:  
너를 사랑하지 말걸 그랬어
I guess I shouldn’t have loved you
연락조차 안 될 때면 죽겠어
It kills me when I can get a hold of you
나만 바라보면 정말 좋겠어
I wish you would only look at me
너에게만 다 줄 거야 Baby you in my heart
I’ll give everything to only you Baby you in my heart
